title: Charles W. Eliot University Professor
bio: Lawrence H. Summers is the Charles W. Eliot University Professor and President Emeritus at Harvard University. During the past four decades he has served in a series of senior policy positions, 71st Secretary of the Treasury for President Clinton, Director of the National Economic Council for President Obama and the Chief Economist of the World Bank.
